in_marathi.name: Akhalesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akhalesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Akhalesh is derived from Sanskrit words 'Akha' meaning 'Immortal' and 'Ish' meaning 'Lord'. This name represents the divine and immortal being who governs the universe.
